_comment: Example STATE_ORTHO_SOURCES config. Point the env var at a copy of this file. The URLs below are FAKE placeholders (.invalid) - replace them with the real ArcGIS ImageServer / MapServer or WMS endpoint published by the state or county GIS office, after checking its terms of use. Objects without a 'url' (like this one) are ignored. The first entry matching the site's 2-letter state and/or whose bbox contains the point is used, so list specific entries (a county bbox) before state-wide ones. Fields: name (shown in logs/meta), states (2-letter codes), bbox ([minlon, minlat, maxlon, maxlat], optional; when set, only points inside match), type ('arcgis_image' -> {url}/exportImage, 'arcgis_map' -> {url}/export, 'wms' -> WMS 1.3.0 GetMap at {url}), url (service root, no trailing /exportImage or /export), layer (WMS LAYERS, or the ArcGIS MapServer layer id sent as layers=show:<id>; optional for ArcGIS), year (capture year, used in the model label), resolution_cm (nominal ground resolution), chip_m (ground width of the square chip in metres, default 120), px (output width/height in pixels, default 1024), token_env (optional name of an env var holding an ArcGIS token; the entry is skipped when that env var is empty).
